subject: General Knowledge
description: Cricket, hockey, football, chess, tennis trophies — high-hit in every banking/SSC paper

questions.stem: The RANJI TROPHY in Indian cricket is associated with:
questions.explanation: Ranji Trophy — India's premier first-class domestic cricket championship, started 1934-35, named after Kumar Shri Ranjitsinhji (Jam Saheb of Nawanagar). Duleep Trophy is inter-zonal; Irani Trophy contests between Ranji champions and Rest of India; Vijay Hazare Trophy is limited-overs. inter-state.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match the SPORT with its TROPHY. A. Hockey.  B. Football (FIFA).  C. Tennis (men's US Open).  D. Chess (world championship). List-II: 1. Sultan Azlan Shah Cup.  2. World Cup.  3. Tiffany & Co. trophy.  4. Botvinnik / no fixed trophy — just the title.
questions.explanation: Sultan Azlan Shah Cup (Malaysia) — hockey. FIFA World Cup — football. Tiffany & Co.-designed US Open trophy. Chess has no universal trophy — champion holds the title (FIDE world champion).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The DURAND CUP is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: Durand Cup — Asia's oldest football tournament (since 1888) and third-oldest in the world. Instituted by Mortimer Durand, British diplomat. Held annually in Kolkata currently. Other football trophies: Santosh Trophy (inter-state), Rovers Cup, DCM Trophy.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The THOMAS CUP and the UBER CUP are awarded in:
questions.explanation: Badminton men's team world championship = Thomas Cup (since 1949). Women's team = Uber Cup (since 1957). Named after Sir George Thomas and Betty Uber. India won the Thomas Cup for the first time in 2022 (Bangkok).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The DAVIS CUP is a prestigious international competition in:
questions.explanation: Davis Cup — international men's tennis TEAM competition (since 1900, originally US vs GB). Women's equivalent: Billie Jean King Cup (formerly Fed Cup). India's notable Davis Cup history features Leander Paes, Mahesh Bhupathi, Ramanathan Krishnan, and son Ramesh Krishnan. national teams.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.explanation: Merdeka Tournament — international football held in Malaysia since 1957 ('merdeka' = independence in Malay). India won it three times (1959, 1964, 1965). Among Asian football's oldest tournaments. Malaysia-hosted.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which of the following trophies is NOT associated with cricket?
questions.explanation: Bombay Gold Cup — awarded in HOCKEY. Ashes is the England-Australia Test cricket series. Ranji and Irani are Indian domestic cricket. (Other hockey trophies: Dhyan Chand Trophy, Beighton Cup, Agha Khan Cup, Rangaswamy Cup.)
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The AGA KHAN CUP is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: Aga Khan Cup — hockey tournament held in Mumbai, instituted 1896 by Aga Khan III. Among India's oldest hockey trophies. Durand Cup = football; Ranji Trophy = cricket.
